brief.en: Breaths icy mist in an area in front of it

description.en: Cold Snapdragons breathe icy mist into 6 adjacent tiles that both slows and damage zombies.
description.zh: 冰龙草向毗邻的 6 格吐出能够减慢僵尸并造成伤害的冰雾。

chat.en: Cold Snapdragon gets chilly when anyone brings up his cousin Snapdragon. "We just view temperature very differently, and I'd really rather not discuss it," he says. Yikes.
chat.zh: 当有人提起他的堂兄火龙草时，冰龙草就会变得冷酷无情。他说：“我们对温度的看法很不一样，而且我真的不想讨论这个问题。”真是的。

text.en: damages and chills all zombies in the 6 tiles in front of it
text.zh: 对身前 6 个格子内的所有僵尸造成伤害并使他们减速
